project_name.justification: The article is titled 'Snowline Gold Consolidates 100% of Its Einarson Project...' and the text states Snowline 'will result in the consolidation of 100% ownership of its Einarson Project'.

company_name.justification: The press release is from 'SNOWLINE GOLD CORP (TSXV:SGD) (OTCQB:SNWGF) (the "Company" or "Snowline")'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The article quotes 'Scott Berdahl, CEO & Director of Snowline' and is signed 'ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD Scott Berdahl CEO & Director'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction is for the 'purchase of a privately held 30% interest in 3,003 mineral claims (~61,000 ha)' to consolidate 100% ownership.

primary_commodity.justification: The article title mentions an 'adjacent gold target' and the text discusses 'orogenic gold system', 'g/t Au', and 'gold targets'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article content is about the consolidation of the Einarson project by Snowline Gold Corp, which matches the project of interest.

currency.justification: The text specifies cash payments in Canadian dollars, for example, 'a cash payment of C$1,200,000'.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The agreement includes future conditional payments specific to the Einarson claims. 'The Vendor will also be entitled to up to seven (7) individual, one-time cash bonus payments of C$1,000,000 in the event of a resource estimate... on any of six specified mineral claim groupings within the consolidated claims...'. This totals C$6,000,000 for the Einarson claims. The initial C$1,200,000 cash payment is not included as it was for a package of assets (Einarson, Venus, etc.) and cannot be disaggregated.

share_payments_raw.justification: The 'one-time share payment of 1,012,000 Snowline shares' is part of the consideration for a package of assets including the 30% interest in Einarson, 100% interest in Venus, other claims, and physical assets. The value attributable solely to the Einarson project is not specified.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Not applicable, as cash and share components of the consideration are listed separately, although they are for a package of assets and cannot be attributed solely to the Einarson project.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The 'one-time share payment of 1,012,000 Snowline shares' is for a package of assets including the 30% interest in Einarson, 100% interest in Venus, other claims, and physical assets. The portion of shares attributable solely to the Einarson project is not specified.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any share warrant payments.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any option payments.

issued_share_price.justification: An issue price for the shares in the transaction is not mentioned, and the shares themselves cannot be attributed solely to the Einarson project.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not mention any exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text does not mention any monetary exploration commitment for the project.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction mentions 'The Vendor will retain a 2% Net Smelter Return (NSR) royalty on the Venus claim block'. This royalty pertains to the Venus project, not the Einarson project.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The acquisition is for a '30% interest in 3,003 mineral claims (~61,000 ha)' which comprise the Einarson project.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The acquisition is for a '30% interest in 3,003 mineral claims (~61,000 ha)' which comprise the Einarson project.

resource_size.justification: The text does not contain a mineral resource estimate for the Einarson project. It mentions bonus payments that are contingent 'in the event of a resource estimate prepared in accordance with NI 43-101 standards', implying no such resource currently exists.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified as 'SNOWLINE GOLD CORP (TSXV:SGD) (OTCQB:SNWGF)'.
